conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm air and I want to get someone out, and I'd also like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

Comfort Club members get the following, per the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md): Standard is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month, and includes two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system and adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both plans also get $500 off any full system replacement.

The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership, and I can't say whether joining would save you money on this visit.
To get someone out for your AC blowing warm air, please give me your full name and one of these: your account number, service address, or phone number.
